_comment: Run template for synthetic-hw-plant-lockout (generated by CAMBER, no real building): the heating plant's warm-weather lockout, boiler and hot-water pump, at the default 65 F lockout. boiler_summer_lockout reads the burner firing (BLR_FIRE), hw_pump_summer_lockout the pump's run status (HWP_STS); both judge occupied hours on the generic weekday schedule, warn at 5 % and fault at 20 % of running hours above the lockout. Measured: PLANT__locked_out and PLANT__low_lockout are ok on both rules; PLANT__warm_spell faults on both (the boiler left enabled through the warm spell, its pump with it); PLANT__pump_left_on is ok on the boiler and faults on the pump. Set summer_lockout_oat_f on boiler_summer_lockout and the pump rule takes the same value.
